ns2:section.sectionText: This section requires departmental approval to enroll. In order to do so, please come in person to 225 DKH. While Econ 465 typically focuses on game theory, the topic of this section is auction theory. It is intended for advanced students with significant mathematical abilities and experience. If you are interested in this topic and have already taken Econ 465, please contact the undergraduate department in 225 DKH. If you have any questions about your qualifications to be successful in this course, please contact Professor Williams at swillia3@illinois.edu.
